item.title: 'Love is Blind' Season 10 returns on Netflix with Ohio cast
item.description: Netflix's popular reality show "Love is Blind" is set to return on February 11 with a cast of 16 men and 16 women from Ohio.

item.title: Ohio bill would task bipartisan group with researching data center concerns
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) -- As Ohio communities push back against an influx of data centers, a new bill would address concerns with a bipartisan task group. item.title: Alleged drug deal leads to deadly west Columbus shooting, deputies say
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) -- A 21-year-old man was charged after an alleged drug deal ended in a deadly shooting, according to the Franklin County Sheriff's Office. item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) -- Columbus City Schools students have been home this entire week because of the cold and snowy weather. item.title: Lawmakers consider bills requiring computer science course for Ohio students
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) -- State lawmakers are considering new legislation that would require all high school students in Ohio to complete at least one computer science course before graduation. House Bill 594 and Senate Bill 326 both have bipartisan support, with sponsors agreeing that kids need a strong computer science education in order to succeed [...]
